import sys
n,m=map(int,input().split())
a=[int(i) for i in input().split()]
def gen(start,end):
    res=set()
    def dfs(i,s):
        if s==m-1:
            print(s)
            sys.exit()
        if i==end:
            res.add(s)
            return
        dfs(i+1,(s+a[i])%m)
        dfs(i+1,s)
    dfs(start,0)
    return res
h=n//2
total=gen(0,h)|gen(h,n)
y=sorted(total)
import bisect
ans=max(i+y[bisect.bisect_left(y,m-i)-1] for i in total)
print(ans)
